free_tier_limits: No paid tier. Free public access: 3 req/s without API key; 10 req/s with free API key (NCBI account). No formal volume cap beyond rate limits and usage policies; contact eutilities@ncbi.nlm.nih.gov for higher throughput.
rate_limits: Without API key: ≤3 requests/second. With API key: ≤10 requests/second. Recommended ≤10 concurrent requests; ≤100 UIDs per multi-UID request (use history for larger sets). NCBI may block abusive IPs.
description: NCBI E-utilities (Entrez Programming Utilities) is a free set of server-side programs for programmatic HTTP access to Entrez/NCBI databases (PubMed, GenBank, Protein, etc.), returning XML, JSON, or other formats depending on utility and parameters. Optional free API key raises rate limits.
